data.desc: Flyte Aviation provides private aviation services with a focus on regional travel aboard the Cirrus Vision Jet. Through Flyte Club, customers can prepay for recurring trips on eligible routes with transparent pricing and personalized booking support. Flyte Aviation, Inc. (NYSE: VJET) is a technology-enabled private aviation company making private air travel simpler, more transparent and increasingly accessible. Through its Flyte brand, the Company operates a growing fleet of state-of-the-art Cirrus Vision Jets and is building a scalable platform connecting customers, aircraft, operators, and aviation services. Flyte's operated charter services are conducted through Ponderosa Air, LLC, an FAA-certified Part 135 air carrier.
